newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Five killed in Zambian oxygen plant explosion.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in Zambian oxygen plant explosion.

text.p: At least five people were killed in an explosion at the state-run Zambia Oxygen plant in the capital Lusaka on Tuesday, police said.
The cause of the explosion, which occured just before midday (1000 GMT) on Tuesday, was not immediately apparent.
"All we know right now is that at least five people died in the explosion. It is not clear what caused it," a police officer on the scene told Reuters. There were no further details.
